offering_description.value: Intuit sells accounting, payroll, payment and marketing tools to businesses, primarily through cloud software. It provides tax software and expert tax preparation to individuals, businesses and tax professionals. Its consumer finance platform offers credit monitoring and matches consumers with financial products from partner institutions.

primary_products.value: Accounting and invoicing software; payroll software; tax preparation software; email marketing and automation software; consumer credit and financial product marketplace

primary_services.value: Payroll and payment processing; expert bookkeeping; tax preparation and advice; small-business financing; credit monitoring and financial product matching

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize businesses, self-employed professionals, accountants, tax preparers, lenders and card issuers; B2C: Individual tax filers and consumers monitoring credit or shopping for financial products

end_markets.value: Small-business financial management; digital marketing; tax preparation; consumer finance; small-business lending

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to accounting, payroll and marketing software; transaction or usage fees: Merchant payment processing and usage-based charges for payroll or tax filings; licensing or royalties: Software licenses for professional tax preparation; service fees: Expert bookkeeping, tax preparation and tax advice; commissions or management fees: Financial institutions pay for qualified referrals or completed customer actions; advertising: Financial institutions pay to promote credit and lending offers; interest or premiums: Interest on eligible small-business loans
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; service fees; commissions or management fees; advertising; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses business and consumer data to deliver accounting, tax, marketing and financial comparison tools; service provider: Combines customer records with professional expertise to deliver bookkeeping, payroll and tax services; financial intermediary: Connects consumers with financial institutions and facilitates merchant payments and small-business financing
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Business accounting, payroll, payments, financing and marketing, plus tax preparation and consumer credit tools

distribution_channels.value: online: Company websites, cloud applications and mobile apps; direct sales: Sales teams serving larger businesses and professional firms; partners / resellers: Accounting firms, advisers and authorized software solution providers; third-party retail: Retailers selling consumer tax software
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; partners / resellers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: IRS e-filing requirements, state licensing rules for regulated payments and lending, and consumer financial privacy rules
